definitions.definition: A taxonomic genus within the family Melanthiaceae – herb Paris and its close relatives, native to Asia and Europe.
The capital and largest city of France.
A department of Île-de-France, France.
The government of France.

A locale named after the French city.
  1. A hamlet in Jutland, Denmark.
  2. A hamlet in New Valley, Egypt.
  3. A former settlement in Yukon, Canada.
  4. A former settlement in Kiritimati, Kiribati.
  5. A locale in the United States.
    1. A city in Arkansas, United States and one of the two county seats of Logan County.
    3. A city, the county seat of Bear Lake County, Idaho.
    4. A city, the county seat of Edgar County, Illinois.
    5. An unincorporated community in Jefferson County and Jennings County, Indiana.
    6. An unincorporated community in Linn County, Iowa.
    7. A city, the county seat of Bourbon County, Kentucky.
    8. A town, the county seat of Oxford County, Maine.
    9. An unincorporated community in Green Charter Township, Mecosta County, Michigan.
    10. A census-designated place in Lafayette County, Mississippi.
    12. A city, the county seat of Monroe County, Missouri; named for the city in Kentucky.
    13. An unincorporated community in the towns of Dummer and Stark, Coos County, New Hampshire.
    14. A town in Oneida County, New York; named for early benefactor Col. Isaac Paris.
    15. A township and unincorporated community therein, in Stark County, Ohio.
    16. An unincorporated community in Lane County, Oregon; named for postmaster G. E. Parris.
    17. A census-designated place in Hanover Township, Washington County, Pennsylvania.
    19. A city, the county seat of Lamar County, Texas.
    21. A city, the county seat of Henry County, Tennessee.
    22. An unincorporated community in Fauquier County, Virginia.
    23. A town in Grant County, Wisconsin.
    24. A town and unincorporated community therein, in Kenosha County, Wisconsin; named for the town in New York.
    25. A number of townships in the United States, listed under Paris Township.
